beats.label: S1 · The wall falls
beats.text: The Colossal Titan breaches Wall Maria and a Titan eats Eren's mother; five years on he, Mikasa and Armin graduate into the military.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Grounds the trauma driving Eren and puts the trio in the military where S2 finds them.

beats.label: S1 · Eren is a Titan
beats.text: The Colossal Titan then breaches Trost; a Titan swallows Eren, but he emerges in his own Titan form and plugs the gate, revealing him as a shifter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Eren's Titan power is the plot engine of every season after this.

beats.label: S1 · A spy in the ranks
beats.text: Erwin wins Eren from execution into the Scouts; someone then kills their two captive test Titans in secret — a spy walks among the soldiers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First hint the enemy is hidden inside their own ranks, paid off when more friends turn out to be shifters.

beats.label: S1 · Female Titan
beats.text: On the 57th Expedition a Female Titan tears through the Scouts trying to abduct Eren, proving another human shifter is serving an enemy outside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the recurring pattern of enemy shifters that defines the war going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Squad wiped
beats.text: The Female Titan slaughters Levi's elite squad and swallows Eren before Levi extracts him, but the shifter escapes back into Scout ranks.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the cost of shifter warfare and that the enemy can escape to strike again.

beats.label: S1 · Annie exposed
beats.text: Armin deduces the Female Titan is their friend Annie Leonhart and lures her into a Stohess ambush, forcing her to transform inside the capital.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Naming an ally as an enemy — the paranoia that fuels S2's Reiner and Bertholdt reveal.

beats.label: S1 · A face in the wall
beats.text: Eren defeats Annie but she seals herself in unbreakable crystal; then a chunk of Wall Sina cracks open, exposing the face of a Titan sealed within.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pivots the show from survival story to conspiracy — S2 opens with Hange chasing this exact mystery.

cliffhanger.text: The walls that were meant to protect humanity are themselves made of Titans. Annie is beyond reach in her own crystal, and Eren and his friends now know human shifters serve an enemy hidden inside the walls.
questions: Why are there giant Titans buried inside the walls?
Who else in the military is a shifter working for whoever attacked Wall Maria?
What is in Grisha's basement that could explain what humanity really is?

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.line: Fifteen-year-old Scout who can transform into a Titan; sworn to exterminate every Titan after his mother was eaten.

characters.name: Mikasa Ackerman
characters.line: Eren's adopted sister and prodigy soldier; she will protect him over anything else.

characters.name: Armin Arlert
characters.line: Eren's brainy friend and the strategist whose deductions unmasked Annie.

characters.name: Levi
characters.line: Captain of the Scouts and humanity's strongest soldier; Eren's handler, and just lost his entire elite squad.

characters.name: Erwin Smith
characters.line: Commander of the Scout Regiment, willing to sacrifice men to uncover the truth of the Titans.

characters.name: Annie Leonhart
characters.line: Former Military Police cadet revealed as the Female Titan; now comatose inside her own crystal, out of reach of interrogation.

characters.name: Hange Zoë
characters.line: Titan researcher and squad leader, obsessed with the Wall Titan reveal and the science behind Eren.

beats.label: S2 · Wall Rose falls
beats.text: Hange finds a Titan sealed inside Wall Sina, and Wall Rose is then breached; an apelike Beast Titan directs the attack and speaks like a man.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Beast Titan is the recurring enemy commander for the seasons that follow.

beats.label: S2 · Ymir and Historia
beats.text: At Castle Utgard the cadet Ymir transforms into a Titan to save her comrades, and Krista Lenz reveals her real name is Historia Reiss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Historia's royal blood is the axis the entire next season turns on.

beats.label: S2 · Reiner and Bertholdt
beats.text: Reiner and Bertholdt confess to Eren they are the Armored and Colossal Titans who broke Wall Maria, then transform and abduct him and Ymir.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes every earlier friendship — the invaders were in the cadet corps all along.

beats.label: S2 · The Coordinate
beats.text: Cornered by the Titan that ate his mother, Eren screams and other Titans obey him, tearing her apart — a power he cannot yet control.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The scream is the first hint of the Founding Titan power that drives the next season's climax.

beats.label: S2 · Titans are humans
beats.text: Hange confirms the Wall Rose Titans were the villagers of Ragako, Conny's mother among them; Titans are people, transformed by an unseen enemy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moral core of the war going forward — the Titans aren't monsters, they're weaponised civilians.

beats.label: S2 · Ymir sides with them
beats.text: Ymir surrenders to Reiner and Bertholdt so she can escape with them; the Scouts recover Eren but the enemy shifters flee toward their homeland.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ymir goes with the invaders alive, holding what she knows about Historia; her absence shapes the next arc.

beats.label: S2 · The man in the ape
beats.text: Atop Wall Maria a bearded man steps out of the Beast Titan and says it is not yet time — a human enemy is coordinating the invasion.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the true enemy as human, not Titan; the next war is against a person.

cliffhanger.text: The Titans are people, turned by an unseen enemy who commands them from beyond the walls. Reiner and Bertholdt have escaped with Ymir toward that enemy, carrying what they know about Eren, and a bearded man in the Beast Titan is planning the next move.
questions: Who is the bearded man commanding the Beast Titan?
What can Eren actually do with the Coordinate — and can he learn to control it?
Historia is the true royal heir — what is the crown hiding from its own people?

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.line: Now knows he carries the Coordinate, a scream that makes Titans obey; still cannot use it on command.

characters.name: Mikasa Ackerman
characters.line: Same combat prodigy, but her fear of losing Eren has hardened into something obsessive.

characters.name: Armin Arlert
characters.line: The trio's strategist; his reads on the enemy have driven every recent victory.

characters.name: Historia Reiss
characters.line: Illegitimate daughter of a nobleman's mistress, forced by the Wall Cult to hide as Krista Lenz; now done hiding.

characters.name: Reiner Braun
characters.line: The Armored Titan — one of the shifters who broke Wall Maria; beaten by Eren but escaped toward his homeland.
characters.note: Was hiding among the 104th cadets for years.

characters.name: Bertholdt Hoover
characters.line: The Colossal Titan; quiet cadet who spent years undercover and fled with Reiner.

characters.name: Ymir
characters.line: A Titan shifter who lived sixty years as a mindless Titan; loyal to Historia, but chose to go with Reiner to protect her.

characters.name: Levi
characters.line: Injured leg from the Female Titan fight; still commanding, still Eren's handler.

characters.name: Erwin Smith
characters.line: Lost his right arm in the rescue; still Commander, and now certain of a human enemy beyond the walls.

characters.name: Hange Zoë
characters.line: Deduced that the walls are made of Titans and that Titans are transformed humans — the science lead for the counterattack.

beats.label: S3 · Kenny attacks
beats.text: A hitman named Kenny wipes out Levi's replacement squad and abducts Eren and Historia; the government fears Eren and wants Historia's royal blood.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the internal conspiracy the Scouts must break before they can face the world outside.

beats.label: S3 · Erwin's coup
beats.text: Erwin exposes the throne as a puppet protecting the Walls' secrets, launches a coup and installs Historia as the true queen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The political reset — Paradis now has a legitimate ruler for the confrontation to come.

beats.label: S3 · Rod becomes a Titan
beats.text: Rod Reiss demands Historia become a Titan and eat Eren to reclaim the Founding Titan; she refuses, and Rod drinks the serum, rampaging as a giant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Founding Titan lore is revealed — the power everyone spends the next season fighting over.

beats.label: S3 · Eren the Founder
beats.text: Trapped in the Reiss cavern, Eren remembers Grisha killing the Reiss family and giving him the Founder; Historia refuses to eat Eren and kills her father instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Eren now carries the Founding Titan; his father stole it, and he'll spend the next season working out why.

beats.label: S3 · Return to Shiganshina
beats.text: The Scouts march on Shiganshina to reach Grisha's basement, but Reiner is waiting inside the wall and the Beast Titan seals them in with a horde of Titans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First face-to-face battle with the outside enemy's shifter team; the outcome resets the board.

beats.label: S3 · Erwin dies, Armin is Colossal
beats.text: Erwin leads a suicide charge so Levi can maul the Beast Titan; Armin burns alive distracting Bertholdt, and Levi feeds the serum to Armin instead of Erwin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reshapes Scout leadership going forward and hands Armin the Colossal power that will matter next season.

beats.label: S3 · The ocean
beats.text: Grisha's books prove a whole world of humans lives beyond the sea; Eren reaches the ocean and asks whether killing everyone out there will finally free them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's true premise is finally spoken aloud — the enemy is a nation of people, and Eren is already sizing them up.

cliffhanger.text: There is a whole world of humans beyond the sea, and the nation of Marley calls Eren's people devils. Erwin is dead, the throne is Historia's, and Eren stands at the ocean asking whether killing everyone on the other side is the only way to be free.
questions: What will Marley do now that Paradis has its own shifters and the Founder?
How far is Eren willing to go with the Founding Titan and Grisha's memories of the future?
Who is the bearded man in the Beast Titan, and how is he tied to Grisha's Marleyan past?

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.line: Now carries the Founding Titan alongside the Attack Titan; can harden his Titan and sees fragments of the future through his father's memories.

characters.name: Mikasa Ackerman
characters.line: Still the Scouts' best fighter, but beginning to see how far Eren will go and how little he asks of her.

characters.name: Armin Arlert
characters.line: Died as a human distracting Bertholdt; Levi injected him with the serum and he now carries the Colossal Titan.

characters.name: Levi
characters.line: Found his dying uncle Kenny at the Reiss estate and chose to save Armin over reviving Erwin; still humanity's strongest.

characters.name: Historia Reiss
characters.line: True queen of the Walls; publicly told her people that the outside world is Marley, and that the throne lied to them for a century.

characters.name: Hange Zoë
characters.line: New Commander of the Scouts after Erwin's death, and the one who leads the survivors home.

characters.name: Erwin Smith
characters.line: Dead. Led the suicide charge that let Levi maul the Beast Titan; his loss defines what the Scouts do next.

characters.name: Reiner Braun
characters.line: Pulled from his Armored Titan at Shiganshina and dragged away by the Cart Titan; still alive, but broken and beaten again.

characters.name: Grisha Yeager
characters.line: Deceased father of Eren, revealed as an Eldian from the outside nation of Marley who stole the Founder from the Reiss family and gave it to Eren.

beats.label: S4 · Marley, and Eren in disguise
beats.text: Four years on, Marley wins its foreign war and turns its Warriors — including Reiner — back toward Paradis; Eren is already in Liberio, disguised and waiting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes the war from the enemy's side and reveals Eren has been off-screen for years running his own plan.

beats.label: S4 · Willy's declaration
beats.text: At a festival Willy Tybur declares war on Paradis; Eren transforms mid-speech, devours him and rampages, and the Scouts fly in with airships to extract him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The ignition of the final war — Eren strikes first, and the world will retaliate.

beats.label: S4 · Sasha and the cell
beats.text: The Scouts win, taking the War Hammer Titan's power, but Warrior candidate Gabi kills Sasha on the way home, and Eren is jailed on Paradis for acting alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sasha's death shatters the Scouts and puts Gabi in their story; Eren's imprisonment lights the political fuse.

beats.label: S4 · The Yeagerists rise
beats.text: A Yeagerist bomb kills Premier Zackly; Eren escapes prison, splits the military and reunites with his half-brother Zeke, who has arrived on Paradis wanting Eren's power.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the Yeagerist regime that ends up ruling Paradis and puts the two brothers in the same country.

beats.label: S4 · The wine and the plan
beats.text: Zeke reveals a plan to sterilise every Eldian; his spinal fluid was fed to Paradis' top brass through wine, and once turned Ragako's villagers into Titans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers Ragako, weaponises the brass, and sets up the Path confrontation between the brothers.

beats.label: S4 · Eren overrides Zeke
beats.text: Eren reaches Zeke in the Paths and uses Grisha's memories to override him; the girl Ymir sides with Eren, and the Wall Titans march out to trample the world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Eren takes the Founder, ignores every plan except his own, and starts the Rumbling — the situation the finale must resolve.

beats.label: S4 · The alliance sails
beats.text: Reiner, Annie, the Marleyans and the remaining Scouts unite to stop Eren and sail from Paradis toward Odiha to catch him before the Rumbling ends the world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The unlikely alliance is the only force still moving against Eren — this is the board the finale opens on.

cliffhanger.text: The Rumbling has started. Thousands of Wall Titans are trampling toward Marley to exterminate every human beyond Paradis, and the only force that can stop Eren is a fragile alliance of yesterday's enemies sailing toward Odiha with a wounded Levi and a broken Reiner.
questions: Can the alliance actually reach and stop Eren before the Rumbling wipes out the world?
Is there still a version of Eren who can be reasoned with, or is he now bound to the Founder Ymir's will?
Who rules Paradis under Floch, and what happens to Historia and her unborn child?

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.line: Older, cold, no longer speaking to his friends; has activated the Rumbling and declared he will destroy every human beyond Paradis.

characters.name: Mikasa Ackerman
characters.line: Joined the alliance to stop Eren; torn between still loving him and knowing she may have to kill him.

characters.name: Armin Arlert
characters.line: Carries the Colossal Titan; on the alliance ship, still hoping Eren can be reasoned back.

characters.name: Levi
characters.line: Grievously wounded when Zeke detonated a Thunder Spear on him; barely alive, being carried by Hange.

characters.name: Hange Zoë
characters.line: Commander of what remains of the Scouts and the effective leader of the alliance.

characters.name: Reiner Braun
characters.line: Broken by guilt but fighting on the alliance's side; helped defend the flying boat at Odiha's port.

characters.name: Annie Leonhart
characters.line: Freed from her crystal when Eren undid all Titan hardening; joined the alliance to try to reach her father in Marley.

characters.name: Zeke Yeager
characters.line: Eren's Marleyan half-brother and holder of the Beast Titan; tried to use Eren for a sterilisation plan and was overridden in the Paths.

characters.name: Gabi Braun
characters.line: Marleyan Warrior candidate who killed Sasha; has since accepted that Paradis is full of people, not devils, and rides with the alliance.

characters.name: Floch Forster
characters.line: Leader of the Yeagerists and effective ruler of Paradis after Eren's departure; will execute anyone who opposes the new empire.
